title: Evaluate proactive work, more workers and richer interaction
description: After the pilot, evaluate scheduled follow-ups, additional worker providers, safe parallel workspaces, optional direct supervisor coding and the chosen richer UI. Split approved candidates into bounded tasks at that time. No always-on service, multi-user system or custom agent marketplace is required for the first release.
why: Preserve the companion-assistant ambition while learning from actual use.

acceptance.text: A user-reviewed use case and success measure exist for each selected expansion
Unselected candidates remain out of release scope

outcome.summary: Deferred until after pilot; candidates listed in expansion gate.
